 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as Chief of Staff in the Office of the Prime Minister, I recused myself, on February 26, 2025 from a discussion or decision regarding a judicial appointment in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official duties and the private interest of my friend, Sunil Mathai.
 In the exercise of my official duties as Chief of Staff in the Office of the Prime Minister, I recused myself, on June 14, 2022, from participating in any discussion or decision regarding a judicial appointment in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to further the private interest of my friend Mr. Ranjan K. Agarwal.
 In the exercise of my official duties as Chief of Staff in the Office of the Prime Minister, I recused myself, on June 17, 2021, from participating in any discussion or decision regarding a judicial appointment in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to improperly further the private interest of Ms. Jill Presser.
